residual_risks: Customer participants are provisioned through the Super Admin invitation UI. The user has not supplied actual recipient emails, so production customer accounts await invitation acceptance.

Previous browser-local selections are not discoverable across devices automatically. Super Admin can import an intact JSON backup while the server document is untouched. Legacy author entries are marked as local-source history, with the import attributed to the logged-in admin.
Agreement confirmations record authenticated accounts and document references. They do not add identity-certified electronic signatures. Planning candidate version identity remains pending.
The workbook requests one-year free defect warranty; duration and start date remain unagreed until explicitly recorded. Maintenance and additional development remain separate paid contracts.

Server state uses bounded requests and an existing twenty-thousand-event validator limit; larger future workloads may need archival/pagination. Existing source-audit implementation findings were not reclassified as passed by this collaboration deployment.
